name: How long does it take to prepare a kitchen wall for a new backsplash?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to prepare a kitchen wall for a new backsplash?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wall preparation time depends on the current condition of your kitchen walls. If the walls are already smooth and clean, preparation might only take a few hours for basic cleaning and masking. However, if old tile needs to be removed, walls need patching, or existing paint needs scuffing and priming, it could take a full day or more. Maine Results, Inc. includes a thorough assessment of wall condition in our initial project planning to provide an accurate timeline, ensuring sufficient time is allocated for proper preparation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Preparation time ranges from a few hours to a full day, depending on wall condition. We assess this during planning for accurate timelines.
